questions.question: Approximately how many English speakers does India have?
questions.explanation: India has the world's second-largest English-speaking population, with over 125 million speakers; English is an official language alongside Hindi.

questions.question: What function does English serve in India?
options: It is an official language and a link language between speakers of different Indian languages
It is spoken only by tourists
questions.explanation: English is one of India's two official languages and serves as a neutral link language among speakers of the country's many languages.

questions.question: What is Singlish?
options: A colloquial variety of English spoken in Singapore, influenced by Chinese and Malay
The official English of the United Kingdom
questions.explanation: Singlish is colloquial Singaporean English, with grammar and vocabulary influenced by Chinese varieties, Malay, and Tamil - famous for particles like "lah".

questions.question: How do Singaporeans typically vary their English?
options: They switch between Standard Singapore English in formal settings and Singlish informally
They speak only Singlish at all times
questions.explanation: Singapore shows classic style-shifting: formal Standard Singapore English in school and government, and informal Singlish among friends.

questions.question: Why are Outer Circle varieties like Indian English considered legitimate varieties rather than "errors"?
options: They have stable, systematic features and serve full social functions in their communities
Because they are identical to British English
Because their speakers are all native speakers of RP
questions.explanation: Varieties like Indian and Singaporean English have consistent grammar, pronunciation, and vocabulary patterns and are used in media, education, and government.
